test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,500 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 2500

Rate = 10%

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (110/100)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × (11/10)²

⇒ Amount = 2500 × 121/100

⇒ Amount = 25 × 121

⇒ Amount = 3025

**∴ The correct answer is 3025.**
